c5149c96c62fdb4f.description: About the Role Vanderlande is seeking a Site Mechanical Supervisor BHS Eng to oversee the installation of mechanical equipment for material handling projects. This full-time position is based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves leading and guiding an installation team, ensuring adherence to safety and quality standards, and contributing to project success from installation through handover. Key Responsibilities Organize and supervise the installation of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for Vanderlande material handling projects, aligning with project schedules. Provide clear instructions to the onsite installation team, ensuring all work complies with quality standards and Vanderlande processes. Promote a culture of safety among the installation team throughout project execution. Conduct surveys of installation areas, verify readiness, and confirm required facilities for installation. Support site handover processes. Maintain a strong onsite presence through regular site walks and a thorough auditing schedule, focusing on safety and quality control in line with Vanderlande standards. Contribute to the creation of the project installation schedule and ensure adherence to meet project timelines. Monitor team progress, identify improvement opportunities, and support continuous enhancement efforts. Report regularly on work progress to the Site Manager, ensuring effective coordination with subcontractors and stakeholders. Train new technicians to enhance their skills, fostering ongoing team improvement and promoting continuous learning. Organize and facilitate all support activities to ensure a smooth commissioning and testing process until handover to the customer. Core Activities and Deliverables The supervisor is directly responsible for performing mechanical installation and mechanical static inspections. Key deliverables include As-Built Notes & Drawings and a Defect List. Consultation is required for activities such as commissioning conveying systems, commissioning safety span of control, creating installation spare parts (ME), developing the site management plan, making EM documentation as-built, and pre-commissioning conveying cabinets, safety systems, and safety PLC cabinets. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in mechanical supervision, particularly within material handling projects. The role requires a strong understanding of mechanical and electromechanical equipment installation, quality standards, and safety protocols. Work Environment and Travel This is a full-time position based in the Makkah region, covering projects in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves significant onsite presence. Travel to project sites is required as necessary for project execution and support, with travel requirements varying based on project needs and locations.

c51919ad512966ca.job_title: Denodo Self Service Data Platform Engineer
c51919ad512966ca.description: About the Role Datamatics Technologies is seeking an experienced Denodo Self Service Data Platform Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on designing, developing, and supporting enterprise data virtualization solutions. The successful candidate will enable business users and analysts to access trusted, secure, and governed data through scalable self-service analytics platforms. Key Responsibilities Design and develop self-service data products, reusable data services, and virtual views using Denodo. Develop and maintain Denodo Virtual DataPort (VDP) views, logical data models, and semantic layers. Integrate data from various sources including databases, cloud platforms, APIs, ERP systems, and SaaS applications. Optimize query performance, caching strategies, and data virtualization architecture. Implement data transformation, data quality rules, and data abstraction layers. Manage data governance, role-based access control (RBAC), data masking, metadata, data cataloging, and lineage. Integrate Denodo with Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, and other BI platforms. Monitor platform performance, troubleshoot issues, and support upgrades and releases. Prepare technical documentation, data dictionaries, operational procedures, and user training materials. Provide Level 2/Level 3 support and collaborate with business and technical teams to improve self-service analytics. Key Deliverables Reusable Denodo virtual views, datasets, and data services. Optimized and scalable data virtualization solutions. Secure and governed enterprise data access. Data catalog, metadata, and lineage documentation. Improved data accessibility and reporting efficiency. Increased adoption of self-service analytics capabilities. Experience Required Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in data virtualization and Denodo platforms. Work Type and Location This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Salary details for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

c5a6900936f3ed71.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة تونتي فايف للتجارة عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جازان. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتقديم معلومات مفصلة حول المنتجات واستخداماتها وأسعارها، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع واستلامها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات دقيقة وشاملة تتعلق بالمنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها ومواصفاتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر، وإصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بكفاءة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل قوية وفعالة. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جازان. يتطلب الدور التواجد في المتجر للتعامل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة المهام اليومية. بيئة العمل يعمل البائع ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء والزملاء. يتم التركيز على تقديم تجربة تسوق إيجابية وضمان رضا العملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

c5c3af96307d11d9.description: About the Role Ericsson is seeking an Automated Operations Engineer Access TX to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. c54de6b66a8807de.description: مدير/ة العمليات واللوجستيات والمالية – استيراد وتصدير جدة | دوام كامل من مقر الشركة نبحث عن قائد عملي لإدارة العمليات اليومية لشركة استيراد وتصدير، يجمع بين الخبرة التشغيلية واللوجستية والمعرفة المحاسبية والضريبية. المهام الرئيسية • إدارة دورة الاستيراد والتصدير من طلب الشراء حتى التسليم. • التنسيق مع الموردين وشركات الشحن والتخليص الجمركي والمستودعات. • متابعة مستندات الشحن، سابر، HS Codes، المخزون والتكلفة الواصلة لكل شحنة. • متابعة الفواتير والمدفوعات والتحصيل والتسويات البنكية وحسابات الموردين والعملاء. • متابعة ضريبة القيمة المضافة والفوترة الإلكترونية ومتطلبات هيئة الزكاة والضريبة والجمارك. • إعداد التقارير التشغيلية والمالية ومؤشرات الأداء وقيادة فريق العمل. المتطلبات • بكالوريوس في المحاسبة أو المالية أو سلاسل الإمداد أو تخصص ذي صلة. • خبرة 5 سنوات أو أكثر في العمليات أو اللوجستيات أو المحاسبة، ويفضل داخل شركة استيراد وتصدير أو تجارة أو توزيع. • معرفة جيدة بالمحاسبة والمخزون والتكاليف وVAT وZATCA. • إجادة Excel ويفضل خبرة في أنظمة ERP. • شخصية قيادية، تنظيم قوي، وحل فعال للمشكلات. • العربية بطلاقة وإنجليزية عملية، مع الاستعداد للعمل من مقر الشركة في جدة. يفضل: عضوية SOCPA أو شهادة VAT، ومعرفة SABER وIncoterms. — English — Operations, Logistics & Finance Manager – Import & Export Jeddah | Full-time, on-site We are seeking a hands-on leader to manage the daily operations of an import and export business, combining strong logistics experience with accounting and tax knowledge. Key Responsibilities • Manage the import/export cycle from purchase order to final delivery. • Coordinate suppliers, freight forwarders, customs brokers and warehouses. • Manage shipping documents, SABER, HS Codes, inventory and landed-cost calculations. • Oversee invoicing, payments, collections, bank reconciliations, AP and AR. • Support VAT, e-invoicing and ZATCA compliance. • Prepare operational and financial reports, monitor KPIs and lead the team. Requirements • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain or a related field. • 5+ years of relevant operations, logistics or accounting experience; import/export, trading or distribution experience is preferred. • Strong knowledge of accounting, inventory, costing, VAT and ZATCA requirements. • Advanced Excel skills; ERP experience is preferred. • Strong leadership, organization and problem-solving skills. • Fluent Arabic and practical English; available to work on-site in Jeddah. Preferred: SOCPA membership or VAT certification, plus knowledge of SABER and Incoterms.

c563aa8677eb814f.description: About Master Works and Adree Adree, a subsidiary of Master Works, specializes in delivering innovative digital solutions that bridge business and technology. The company's expertise includes Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Low-Code/No-Code development, application performance, and application lifecycle management. Role Overview Adree is seeking a Delivery Manager to lead the end-to-end delivery of complex technology projects and digital solutions. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 5-10 years of experience. The successful candidate will ensure projects are executed successfully within agreed timelines, scope, quality, and budget. Key Responsibilities Lead the end-to-end delivery of software development, digital transformation, and IT projects from initiation through deployment and handover. Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, quality, risks, and dependencies. Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams including software development, QA, DevOps, business analysis, and other technical functions. Act as the primary point of contact for clients and key stakeholders, managing expectations, requirements, escalations, and delivery updates. Manage Agile/Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery methodologies, including sprint planning, backlog management, and delivery governance. Monitor project progress and delivery performance through KPIs, SLAs, sprint velocity, burndown, defect rates, and milestone completion. Identify and resolve project risks, issues, blockers, and dependencies in a timely manner. Manage relationships with vendors, third-party providers, and technology partners. Ensure solutions meet business requirements, technical standards, quality expectations, and compliance requirements. Manage project resources, team capacity, workload, and delivery priorities. Monitor project financial performance and ensure delivery remains within the approved budget. Coordinate project planning, status reporting, governance meetings, and executive-level updates. Ensure effective testing, quality assurance, deployment, and client handover. Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and post-implementation reviews. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience delivering large-scale enterprise software, web, mobile, or digital transformation projects. Strong experience in client-facing project delivery and stakeholder management. Experience managing external vendors, third-party providers, and technology partners. Strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and/or hybrid delivery methodologies. Good understanding of SDLC, software development, cloud technologies, APIs, microservices, and enterprise applications. Experience working with technologies such as .NET, Azure, OutSystems, Creatio, or similar enterprise technology platforms is preferred. Experience with delivery and project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and MS Project. Strong understanding of project financial management, resource planning, risk management, and delivery governance. PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or similar certifications are preferred. Previous experience in a technology consultancy, system integrator, or client-site delivery environment is preferred. Saudi/GCC market experience is preferred. Required Skills Excellent communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Strong ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage delivery without direct hierarchical authority.

c59ecc7621c152f6.description: A leading company in Real Estate Development and Construction of mega projects, is looking for an Office Manager for the Deputy CEO to work in our head office in Riyadh city. Job Purpose: The Office Manager (Secretary) will primarily manage and coordinate the daily operations of the Deputy CEO's office, ensuring smooth administrative, logistical, and communication support so the Deputy CEO can focus on strategic and operational priorities across the project. Key Responsibilities: Manage the Deputy CEO's calendar, meetings, travel, and correspondence, prioritizing competing demands. Act as the primary point of contact between the Deputy CEO's office and internal departments, external stakeholders, contractors, and government entities. Prepare, review, and edit reports, presentations, minutes of meetings, and official correspondence (English/Arabic). Track action items and follow up on deliverables across departments on behalf of the Deputy CEO. Coordinate high-level meetings, site visits, and events, including logistics and briefing materials. Handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion. Liaise with PMO, HR, Finance, and Project teams to ensure timely information flow to/from the Deputy CEO's office. Manage office budget, supplies, and vendor coordination for the executive office. Supervise administrative/support staff within the office, if applicable. Support ad hoc strategic initiatives and special projects as assigned by the Deputy CEO. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field. 8–12 years of experience in an executive office/office management role, preferably supporting C-suite or senior leadership in construction, real estate, or large-scale infrastructure/high-rise projects. Skills & Competencies: Fluent English (spoken and written); Arabic fluency highly preferred/required. Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication. High discretion and professionalism handling confidential matters. Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with document/PMO systems a plus. Strong stakeholder management across executive, technical, and government levels. Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced project environment.

Professional Engineer (PE) license or relevant certifications, demonstrating a commitment to industry standards and ethics. c5a7e4c331edb307.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to join their team in Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves planning and supervising all maintenance activities for electrical equipment within the plant, working under the direction of the Section Head. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Assign preventive and corrective maintenance jobs as directed by the Section Head. Supervise and coordinate the activities of maintenance staff. Maintain records, prepare reports, and compose correspondence related to work. Execute work orders through CMMS (SAP) and coordinate with the planning engineer for job completion and technical matters. Ensure necessary communications and relations are maintained to report on status and ensure corrective actions are undertaken. Assist the Maintenance Manager in executing corrective and planned maintenance in line with the annual scheduled maintenance plan. Perform technical evaluation of quotations from the purchase department and recommend appropriate choices. Prepare purchase requisitions for spare parts and consumables, ensuring budgetary constraints and strategic spares availability. Review and recommend new maintenance procedures and work instructions. Supervise, direct, and coordinate the activities of all personnel assigned to the area. Ensure Environmental Aspect-Impact and Hazard Risk Assessments are carried out, controlled, and updated. Implement, monitor, and report IMS objectives, targets, and programs. Provide necessary resources for effective implementation and sustenance of IMS. Report IMS performance to management periodically. Ensure legal, contractual, and organizational compliance within the scope of activities. Identify root causes for non-conformances/deviations and implement corrective/preventive actions. Identify competency gaps for subordinate personnel and implement necessary actions. Carry out annual performance evaluations of reporting employees. Provide on-the-job training to new employees and evaluate their OJT performance. Identify, document, and control hazards in the assigned work area. Ensure identified aspects are monitored and operational controls are followed. Report deviations in the Integrated Management System, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Report emergencies, incidents, and near misses. Ensure effective resource utilization. Perform other duties as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within a plant maintenance environment. Proficiency in using CMMS (SAP) for work order execution and coordination. Strong understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance principles. Ability to perform technical evaluations and manage procurement processes for spare parts. Work Environment The role involves working in a plant environment where the employee may occasionally encounter moving mechanical parts and varying outside weather conditions. There may be exposure to high precarious places, fumes, airborne particles, toxic chemicals, and electrical shock. The typical noise level is moderate, though very loud conditions can occur.

c546f2f8cb64284d.description: The FP&A Manager for Operating Assets will be responsible for management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, analysis, and performance monitoring of some of Qiddiya’s operating assets, including theme parks, hotels, golf courses, and sports venues. This role serves as a bridge between the FP&A department, the Finance Business Partner function, and the Asset Management/Operating Assets teams, working closely with FBPs to provide decision support, performance insights, and strategic financial recommendations. Essential duties and responsibilities: Lead the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial plans for operating assets in collaboration with FBPs and Asset Management Support scenario planning for pre-opening, ramp-up, and stabilization phases of assets Track and analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts, providing variance analysis and actionable insights to FBPs, asset managers, and leadership Develop dashboards and performance reports in collaboration with the FP&A reporting team using tools like Power BI and Anaplan Bachelor's degree in finance or business management. c5560b6430a55923.description: Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments. We are seeking a Senior Design Manager - MEP (Electrical) to join JASARA PMC. The Senior Design Manager – MEP (Electrical) oversees consultant-led electrical and power system design activities across all project stages, ensuring compliance with requirements, approved design briefs, Scopes of Work (SOW), applicable electrical standards, and authority regulations. The role provides technical leadership and design governance for all electrical engineering disciplines, including power distribution, low voltage (LV) systems, medium voltage (MV) interfaces, substations, switchgear, emergency power systems, ELV integration, and smart city infrastructure. The position ensures electrical designs are coordinated with architectural, structural, mechanical, infrastructure, and specialist disciplines to deliver safe, reliable, efficient, and construction-ready solutions. The Senior Design Manager does not undertake detailed design production but is responsible for reviewing, guiding, and assuring the quality, coordination, compliance, and deliverability of consultant design outputs while supporting the Design Director in technical assurance, cost alignment, value engineering, and delivery readiness. Design Leadership & Governance Oversee, coordinate, and monitor all electrical and power system design activities throughout concept, schematic, detailed design, and construction documentation stages. Lead design governance processes related to electrical engineering, including design reviews, technical compliance reviews, change management, and stage-gate approvals. Ensure all electrical designs comply with standards, Saudi Building Code, SEC requirements, IEC standards, NFPA standards, and applicable international best practices. Establish and maintain electrical design standards, specifications, and technical guidelines across the project portfolio. Consultant Management Manage electrical, MEP, and multidisciplinary consultants, ensuring compliance with approved design briefs, SOWs, project requirements, and quality standards. Review and challenge consultant submissions to ensure optimum technical solutions, operational efficiency, maintainability, and lifecycle value. Monitor consultant performance, deliverable quality, programme adherence, and technical compliance. Participate in consultant selection, technical evaluations, and procurement activities. Electrical Systems Oversight Provide technical oversight for the design and integration of: Medium Voltage (MV) Infrastructure Low Voltage (LV) Distribution Systems LV Switchgear and Main Distribution Boards Substations and Electrical Rooms Emergency and Backup Power Systems UPS Systems Generator Systems Earthing and Lightning Protection External Power Networks Street Lighting Systems Smart City Electrical Infrastructure ELV Interfaces and Building Technologies Multidisciplinary Coordination Act as the primary electrical design interface across all disciplines. Ensure electrical requirements are fully integrated with architectural, structural, mechanical, ICT, security, transportation, and utility infrastructure designs. Lead coordination workshops to identify and resolve design clashes, interface risks, and operational concerns. Ensure electrical systems support overall project functionality, resilience, sustainability, and operational objectives. Technical Assurance & Design Review Review engineering calculations, electrical studies, and design reports including: Load Demand Assessments Load Flow Studies Short Circuit Analysis Protection Coordination Studies Arc Flash Studies Power Quality Assessments Reliability and Redundancy Analysis Verify design compliance, constructability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Ensure design solutions support long-term asset management strategies and operational requirements. Cost, Value Engineering & Risk Management Work closely with Development, Commercial, and Cost Management teams to align electrical designs with approved budgets and project objectives. Lead value engineering reviews without compromising safety, performance, reliability, or operational requirements. Identify technical risks, programme impacts, and cost implications and recommend mitigation measures. Support lifecycle cost assessments and whole-life asset value optimization. Construction & Delivery Support Apply strong construction and execution knowledge to ensure electrical design packages are practical, coordinated, and ready for implementation. c5a47cd8e8416bc6.description: We’re looking for a highly technical Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise customer engagement platforms for large, complex organizations. This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and in a technical design review. You’ll understand how the business sells, serves, and engages its customers, shape the target architecture across Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, and guide delivery teams through to a production-ready, scalable solution. You’ll work on enterprise-scale transformation programmes with multiple workstreams, demanding stakeholders, and real accountability for outcomes. We want someone who brings a point of view, not just someone who executes a specification. You should have shaped solutions, defended architectural decisions, and seen them through go-live. What You'll Do ❏ Lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, current-state processes, and customer engagement requirements. ❏ Define end-to-end target architectures across Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, and Customer Insights (Data and Journeys). ❏ Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, balancing configuration, low-code, and custom development. ❏ Make and document key architectural decisions, including fit-gap and out-of-the-box vs. custom approaches, environment strategy, data model design, and the security model. ❏ Design the Dataverse data model, the security architecture (business units, security roles, teams, field-level security), and the approach to data migration from legacy CRM systems. ❏ Design integrations between Dynamics 365 and enterprise platforms such as ERP (including Finance & Operations), marketing, telephony, identity, and data platforms, using Azure Integration Services, APIs, and event-driven patterns. ❏ Define the solution approach across the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Copilot Studio. ❏ Provide technical leadership to development teams, including design and code reviews for plugins, PCF controls, and custom workflows, development standards, and ALM through Azure DevOps or Power Platform Pipelines. ❏ Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and data privacy requirements, including regional data residency where applicable. ❏ Contribute to solutioning, estimation, and scoping of new phases and change requests. ❏ Prototype and validate approaches before full implementation to reduce delivery risk. ❏ Identify opportunities to use Copilot and AI capabilities across Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform where they create real business value. ❏ Advise clients on platform roadmap, licensing implications, and adoption best practice. ❏ Produce high-quality architecture artefacts, including solution designs, integration specifications, data models, and technical decision records. ❏ Collaborate with functional consultants, data, integration, and delivery leads throughout discovery, design, build, and optimization. ❏ 10+ years in enterprise technology, including 6+ years architecting on Dynamics 365 CE / CRM. ❏ A track record of leading Dynamics 365 implementations end to end on large-scale, multi-workstream programmes. ❏ Experience in a consulting or systems integration environment, delivering for enterprise clients in a structured, client-facing delivery model. ❏ Deep hands-on expertise in Dynamics 365 and Dataverse, including data modelling, the security model, business process flows, plugins, and the Web API. ❏ Strong working knowledge of the Power Platform and its governance, including environments, DLP policies, and the CoE approach. ❏ Solid integration and Azure skills, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, API Management, and Azure Synapse Link / Microsoft Fabric. ❏ Experience leading data migration from legacy CRM platforms (for example, older Dynamics versions or Salesforce). ❏ The ability to communicate architecture clearly to senior business stakeholders and technical teams alike. ❏ Comfort working independently in a contract capacity and getting productive quickly within established client teams. Nice to Have ❏ Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600) or Dynamics 365 functional certifications. ❏ Experience with Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Omnichannel, or Field Service at scale. ❏ Experience in regulated or public-sector environments, such as financial services, government, or telecoms. ❏ GCC client experience and/or Arabic language skills.

c5f0498e88fa2af6.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a TCC Liaison Officer to ensure seamless coordination between the Transportation Control Centre (TCC) and operational teams during the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) phase of a metro project. This full-time role is critical for maintaining smooth traffic management, timely incident response, and effective communication among all stakeholders involved in metro operations. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The TCC Liaison Officer acts as a primary point of contact, facilitating efficient communication and operational continuity. This role supports the TCC in real-time monitoring, dispatch coordination, and operational decision-making, ensuring that information flows accurately and promptly between control center personnel and field teams. Key Responsibilities Facilitate coordination between the Transportation Control Centre (TCC) and operational teams to ensure efficient traffic management and operational continuity. Act as the primary liaison for incident response, ensuring timely communication and resolution of service disruptions. Support the TCC in real-time monitoring, dispatch coordination, and operational decision-making. Ensure accurate and timely information flow between control center personnel and field teams. Assist in the development and implementation of incident management protocols and response strategies. Collaborate with O&M Contractors, technical teams, and Employer representatives to align operational priorities and ensure compliance with safety and service standards. Minimum of 5 years of experience in transportation management systems, preferably within metro or urban rail environments. Experience in metro or railway infrastructure projects. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working in high-pressure, real-time operational settings. Familiarity with control center technologies, dispatch systems, and incident tracking tools. c50a033ade697158.description: About Al Ghurair Al Ghurair is seeking a Financial Services Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on developing and managing the company's automotive financial services ecosystem. This role involves building and managing strategic partnerships with various financial service providers, negotiating competitive financing programs, and enabling the Sales team. Coordinate finance applications with partners and resolve issues affecting approval or vehicle delivery. Monitor key performance indicators including penetration, approval ratio, conversion, turnaround time, and partner service levels. Conduct regular business reviews with financial providers and follow up on agreed actions. Prepare monthly dashboards and forecasts for the EVP. Train the Sales Department on partner products, eligibility criteria, and current campaigns. Responsibilities include: Producing professional advertising videos and developing creative content. Creating innovative content for social media platforms. Brainstorming trendy ideas and marketing campaigns to attract audiences. Appearing in videos or coordinating appearances as needed. Writing catchy titles and marketing texts suitable for the content. Editing videos and adding audio and visual effects. Monitoring trends and analyzing content performance to continuously improve ideas. Features of the position include: A creative work environment. c55569fee66477a8.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking an IT/Telecom Enterprise Architecture Senior Manager to join the Owner's IT and Telecom Infrastructure team. This full-time role involves overseeing the operation, maintenance, performance, and continuous improvement of mission-critical Data Center and Telecom systems for a large-scale project. The position requires strong technical expertise, leadership capabilities, and experience managing complex infrastructure operations within transportation or public infrastructure environments. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee the operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of the Data Center and Telecom infrastructure, ensuring high availability, reliability, and operational excellence. Act as the Owner's representative for all IT and Telecom operational matters, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, project requirements, and industry best practices. Manage, supervise, and provide technical direction to the IT and Telecom Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Contractor, ensuring services are delivered in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Lead a multidisciplinary team of specialists, engineers, inspectors, and technical experts responsible for monitoring and auditing the performance of IT and Telecom assets and associated maintenance activities. Establish and implement performance management frameworks, monitoring tools, KPI dashboards, and reporting mechanisms to measure contractor effectiveness and system performance. Ensure proactive maintenance strategies are implemented to maximize system availability, minimize downtime, and improve asset reliability. Monitor and manage telecom systems, including fiber optic networks, communication infrastructure, WAN/LAN networks, wireless systems, CCTV, passenger information systems, and other operational technologies supporting public transport services. Oversee Data Center operations, including servers, storage systems, virtualization platforms, backup and disaster recovery solutions, and network infrastructure. Ensure compliance with all applicable cybersecurity regulations, standards, and policies within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including risk management, vulnerability assessments, incident response, and security audits. Coordinate with internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and government authorities to ensure seamless operation and integration of IT and Telecom systems. Review and approve maintenance plans, technical reports, operational procedures, and asset management documentation. Identify operational risks and develop mitigation strategies to ensure business continuity and uninterrupted transport services. Support future technology upgrades, system enhancements, and digital transformation initiatives across the project. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in IT/Telecom infrastructure operations and management. Demonstrated leadership capabilities in managing complex infrastructure operations. Experience within large-scale transportation or public infrastructure environments is required. Strong technical expertise in Data Center and Telecom systems. Required Skills Proficiency in managing IT and Telecom infrastructure, including fiber optic networks, WAN/LAN, wireless systems, CCTV, and passenger information systems. Expertise in Data Center operations, including servers, storage, virtualization, backup, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of cybersecurity regulations, risk management, and incident response. Ability to establish and implement performance management frameworks and monitoring tools. Strong communication and coordination skills for engaging with stakeholders, contractors, and authorities. Work Type This is a full-time position.

c585f9bb60b18483.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a QA Engineer to join its site-based Construction Supervision team in Riyadh. This full-time position is for a major landmark development project that includes the design, enabling, and main works for a large-scale destination, featuring iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. Project Context The project operates under a client governance framework with stringent requirements for program, quality, safety, and sustainability. The Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) is responsible for providing independent, end-to-end supervision and management, ensuring all works are completed, integrated, tested, commissioned, and handed over to support successful operations and long-term legacy objectives. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain the Project Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with Parsons and client requirements. Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with approved quality standards, specifications, and procedures. Conduct quality audits, inspections, and surveillance activities across project sites. Review and approve Quality Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and related quality documentation. Identify, document, and track Non-Conformances (NCRs), Corrective Actions, and Preventive Actions (CAPA). Analyze quality performance trends and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. c5d1f9db28f77884.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم وتنسيق مبادرات التطوير التنظيمي، بما في ذلك الهياكل الوظيفية، إدارة الأداء، والسياسات، بهدف تعزيز فعالية القوى العاملة والكفاءة التشغيلية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد ومراجعة وتحديث الهياكل والملفات الوظيفية. دعم تحديد الأهداف والتقييمات ووثائق إدارة الأداء. تطوير ومراجعة سياسات وإجراءات وأدلة الموارد البشرية. تنسيق مبادرات الارتباط الوظيفي والثقافة وإدارة التغيير. حفظ سجلات الهياكل والتقييمات ووثائق التطوير التنظيمي. تنفيذ تحليل الوظائف ودعم تخطيط القوى العاملة والتصميم التنظيمي. تنسيق تحليل الاحتياجات التدريبية ومبادرات التطوير. إعداد التقارير والعروض وتحليل مؤشرات فعالية المنظمة. متابعة إنجاز التقييمات والأنشطة مع المديرين. دعم أطر الكفاءات والمسارات المهنية ومشروعات التحسين ومتابعة تقدمها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الموارد البشرية أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنسيق ودعم مبادرات التطوير التنظيمي. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الموارد البشرية في شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

c5e4a4b83a714998.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كارامتارا المتجددة السعودية عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان الالتزام التام بأنظمة ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة (HSE) المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية، وسياسات السلامة الخاصة بالشركة، والمعايير الدولية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطبيق ومتابعة سياسات وإجراءات وتعليمات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وفقًا لمعايير الشركة والأنظمة المحلية. ضمان الالتزام بمتطلبات OSHA وISO 45001 ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة الخاصة بالعملاء. إجراء جولات تفتيش يومية في مواقع العمل لتحديد السلوكيات والممارسات غير الآمنة وظروف العمل غير الآمنة. إجراء تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل سلامة المهام (JSA) قبل بدء الأعمال. الإشراف على متطلبات السلامة أثناء أعمال تصنيع الهياكل الفولاذية والجلفنة واللحام والقطع والدهان والتجميع والتحميل وتصنيع أبراج خطوط نقل الكهرباء. متابعة عمليات الرفع باستخدام الرافعات والرافعات الشوكية والمعدات الثقيلة. تنفيذ برامج التوعية والتعريف بمتطلبات السلامة للموظفين والمقاولين الجدد. تقديم اجتماعات السلامة اليومية (Toolbox Talks) وبرامج التوعية بالسلامة بشكل دوري. التحقيق في الحوادث والحوادث الوشيكة وظروف العمل غير الآمنة، وإعداد تقارير التحقيق. تنظيم تدريبات الإخلاء في حالات الطوارئ والتمارين الوهمية، والتنسيق مع فرق الاستجابة للطوارئ. حفظ سجلات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، وتقارير التفتيش والحوادث، وإعداد التقارير الدورية للإدارة. متابعة مدى التزام المقاولين من الباطن بمتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وتقييم أدائهم. فحص معدات وأدوات الرفع والأدوات الكهربائية والمعدات والآلات وأجهزة السلامة. تقديم التوصيات والمقترحات التي تسهم في تعزيز مستوى السلامة في بيئة العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بأنظمة ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة (HSE) في المملكة العربية السعودية. فهم لمتطلبات OSHA وISO 45001. القدرة على إجراء تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل سلامة المهام. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتدريب والتوعية بالسلامة. القدرة على التحقيق في الحوادث وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية بدوام كامل في منشآت تصنيع خطوط نقل الكهرباء ومواقع المشاريع التابعة لشركة كارامتارا المتجددة السعودية في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف الدور إلى توفير بيئة عمل آمنة والحد من الإصابات والحوادث المهنية ومنع وقوعها. التحسين المستمر يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في دعم تطبيق مبادرات السلامة القائمة على السلوك (BBS) ومساعدة الإدارة في تحقيق أهداف ومؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) الخاصة بالصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشروع. كما يشارك في اجتماعات لجنة الصحة والسلامة والبيئة لتقديم التوصيات والمقترحات التي تعزز مستوى السلامة.

c5504e1b005fc47d.description: About Alstom and the Role Alstom is a global leader in sustainable and smart mobility, offering a comprehensive portfolio of transport solutions including high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, as well as turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility. This full-time position for an ISR Training Manager is based in Riyadh, where you will contribute to a significant rail project. Role Overview The ISR Training Manager will be responsible for the successful delivery of the ISR training package for the Riyadh Metro Line 2 (Red Line) extension. This role involves close collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders, including the customer, consortium partners, Operations and Maintenance entities, project teams, suppliers, and ISR stakeholders. The manager will oversee the development and execution of training programs, ensuring alignment with project milestones and quality standards. A key focus will be defining the training strategy and managing the Transfer of Technology (ToT) process, alongside coordinating all training activities. Key Responsibilities Define a contract-compliant training strategy that incorporates Transfer of Technology (ToT) requirements. Conduct training needs assessments and develop tailored training plans. Forecast and organize necessary facilities, materials, and digital equipment for training. Coordinate the preparation, production, and distribution of training documents and materials. Evaluate trainees, confirm qualifications, and maintain accurate training records. Build, update, and manage the training schedule. Monitor compliance with contractual, safety, quality, and project requirements. Identify risks and implement mitigation and recovery actions. Track training costs and resource utilization against the approved budget. Collect feedback and analyze training performance to drive continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in training management, ideally within a relevant industry. The role requires expertise in defining training strategies, managing Transfer of Technology processes, and coordinating complex training programs for large-scale projects. Work Environment and Benefits This role offers the opportunity to work within a collaborative and dynamic team environment on an innovative rail project in Riyadh. Alstom provides a flexible and inclusive workplace, with investment in employee development through learning programs. c553d2d450896953.description: The Quality Control Engineer is responsible for inspecting, monitoring, and ensuring the quality of all finishing, interior fit-out, natural stone, and marble installation works in accordance with approved shop drawings, project specifications, material submittals, method statements, and applicable quality standards. The role requires strong technical expertise in architectural finishes, high-end interior fit-out, stone and marble fabrication and installation, ensuring that all works meet the required standards of workmanship, dimensional accuracy, alignment, levelness, joint consistency, surface finish, and overall aesthetic quality. The QC Engineer shall coordinate with site engineers, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and project management teams to identify quality issues, prevent defects, and ensure that all completed works comply with project requirements before handover. Key Responsibilities 1. Finishing and Interior Fit-Out Quality Control Inspect all architectural finishing and interior fit-out activities, including flooring, wall cladding, ceilings, gypsum works, painting, tiling, joinery, doors, decorative finishes, and other interior works. Ensure all executed works comply with approved shop drawings, technical specifications, material approvals, and project quality requirements. Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, verticality, surface flatness, edge details, and finishing quality. Inspect interfaces between different finishing materials to ensure proper coordination, clean transitions, and high-quality workmanship. Conduct site inspections at each stage of work to identify defects before subsequent activities proceed. 2. Stone and Marble Quality Control Perform detailed inspections of natural stone and marble materials, including marble, granite, limestone, travertine, and other decorative stone finishes. Verify material type, color, veining, texture, thickness, dimensions, finish, and overall consistency against approved samples and material submittals. Inspect stone and marble slabs, tiles, and fabricated pieces for cracks, chips, scratches, stains, discoloration, edge damage, and other visual or dimensional defects. Verify slab selection, vein matching, bookmatching, grain direction, color consistency, and layout patterns in accordance with approved drawings and samples. Inspect stone fabrication, cutting, edge profiling, mitre joints, corner details, openings, cut-outs, and polishing quality. Monitor stone and marble installation, ensuring correct setting-out, alignment, levelness, joint width, lippage control, fixing systems, adhesive application, and anchoring methods. Verify substrate preparation, waterproofing where applicable, backing supports, mechanical fixing systems, and installation methods according to approved details and manufacturer recommendations. Inspect grouting, joint filling, sealant application, staining protection, cleaning, polishing, and final finishing. Ensure proper handling, transportation, storage, and protection of stone and marble materials to prevent damage before and after installation. Identify and report unacceptable workmanship, material defects, and installation deviations, and ensure corrective actions are completed. 3. Inspection and Quality Documentation Prepare and submit Inspection Requests (IRs/WIRs) and coordinate inspections with the consultant and client representatives. Review approved shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and project specifications before work execution. Maintain inspection records, checklists, material inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and quality documentation. Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for defective or non-compliant works and follow up on corrective and preventive actions. Verify that corrective works have been completed satisfactorily before requesting reinspection. Maintain photographic records of site inspections, defects, corrective actions, and completed works. Support the preparation of snag lists, de-snagging inspections, and final handover documentation. 4. Site Coordination and Quality Assurance Coordinate with site engineers, finishing engineers, subcontractors, stone suppliers, fabrication workshops, consultants, and project management teams. Review and inspect mock-ups and sample installations before approving or recommending approval for mass production and installation. Monitor workmanship during execution and provide technical guidance to prevent recurring quality defects. Ensure materials and workmanship are consistent with approved samples, design intent, project specifications, and client expectations. Participate in quality meetings, progress inspections, and technical coordination meetings. Ensure completed works are properly protected against damage caused by subsequent construction activities. Monitor compliance with approved quality procedures, relevant standards, and project-specific requirements. 5. Final Inspection and Handover Conduct final quality inspections of completed finishing, fit-out, stone, and marble works. Verify uniformity of finishes, joint consistency, alignment, surface condition, cleanliness, and overall visual appearance. Identify and document defects, incomplete works, and deviations from approved requirements. Follow up on snagging and de-snagging activities until all quality issues are resolved. Ensure proper cleaning, sealing, polishing, protection, and maintenance requirements are completed before handover. Assist in compiling quality records and handover documents. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in construction quality control, preferably in finishing, interior fit-out, and high-end architectural projects. Strong hands-on experience in natural stone and marble fabrication, installation, inspection, and finishing. Practical knowledge of marble and stone flooring, wall cladding, countertops, staircases, vanity tops, decorative stone features, and custom stonework. Good understanding of architectural drawings, shop drawings, material specifications, method statements, and installation details. Experience in preparing inspection requests, quality checklists, NCRs, and inspection reports. Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management principles and project-specific QA/QC procedures. Proficiency in reading construction drawings and using AutoCAD and Microsoft Office is preferred. Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and reporting skills. A

c581bae4ce60fe0d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دار السمار للمقاولات عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة المتنوعة للمشاريع الإنشائية، بما في ذلك الأبنية والطرق. يتطلب الدور خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المساحة. المهام الرئيسية يتولى فني المساحة مسؤولية تنفيذ مجموعة واسعة من المهام المساحية الأساسية للمشاريع، بدءاً من المسح الاستكشافي وصولاً إلى رسم الخرائط النهائية. تشمل المهام الرئيسية ما يلي: تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية للمشاريع الإنشائية المختلفة وإعداد مسودات بالمنشآت والعوائق والقنوات والطرق الفرعية. تحديد نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط وتثبيتها، واختيار أنواع الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية اللازمة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية المختلفة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية من المخططات على الأرض. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات وتثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها، وتوقيع المنحنيات المختلفة بحسب المخططات. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية والمنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة المختلفة. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك الخبرة العملية اللازمة في مجال المساحة، مع القدرة على تطبيق المعرفة النظرية في بيئة العمل الميدانية. تشمل المتطلبات الأساسية ما يلي: خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في أعمال المساحة. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية المساحية. إتقان إجراء المسح اللازم لمشاريع الأبنية والطرق. المهارة في رسم الخرائط والمخططات المساحية. بيئة العمل سيعمل فني المساحة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة دار السمار للمقاولات في مدينة الباحة. تتطلب طبيعة العمل التواجد في المواقع الإنشائية لتنفيذ المهام المساحية المختلفة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

c5d3ee2c2da27231.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مجموعة الشريف وكي اي سي عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في بيشة، بمنطقة عسير. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث يركز على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية ومتابعة تنفيذها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية، وتحديد مساراتها بدقة. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. وضع برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات الكهربائية وتشخيص الأعطال. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتشخيص الأعطال. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. الالتزام بتطوير أساليب العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق مجموعة الشريف وكي اي سي في بيشة، عسير، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على الجودة والكفاءة في تنفيذ المشاريع الكهربائية. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق متخصص والمساهمة في مشاريع هندسية مهمة. لم يتم الكشف عن الراتب لهذا الدور.

c504faa7eafad734.description: Job Summary We are seeking a qualified Electrical Engineer to join our contracting and construction company. The candidate will supervise electrical and low-current works on site, coordinate electrical subcontractors, and ensure that installations comply with approved designs, specifications and authority requirements. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering. Minimum 5–7 years of site experience in electrical works for building projects. Valid Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) membership. Good knowledge of power distribution, lighting, low-current systems (fire alarm, data, CCTV) and earthing. Familiarity with SBC and Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) requirements. Experience in testing and commissioning of electrical systems. Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office. Good communication and coordination skills. Key Responsibilities Supervise the installation of electrical power, lighting and low-current systems. Ensure works comply with approved shop drawings, specifications and SEC requirements. Coordinate with civil and mechanical teams to resolve interfaces. Review electrical material submittals and shop drawings. Monitor electrical subcontractors’ progress, manpower and materials. Raise inspection requests and attend inspections with QA/QC and the consultant. Plan and witness testing and commissioning of electrical systems. Coordinate permanent power connection with SEC. Prepare electrical progress reports and as-built documentation.

c52ac33b6b46e1e2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اجال للمختبرات عن فني كيميائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في نجران. يقوم شاغل هذه الوظيفة بتنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية المتعلقة باستقبال وتجهيز وتحليل العينات، وإجراء الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الإجراءات والمعايير المعتمدة. يتطلب الدور الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية وإجراءات التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال وتجهيز وتحضير العينات لإجراء الفحوصات والتحاليل. تنفيذ الاختبارات والتحاليل الكيميائية والمخبرية وفق الطرق والإجراءات المعتمدة. تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية والتأكد من جاهزيتها للاستخدام. تحضير المحاليل والكواشف والمواد اللازمة لإجراء الاختبارات. تسجيل وإدخال نتائج التحاليل في الأنظمة المعتمدة ومراجعة دقتها. تطبيق إجراءات ضبط ومراقبة الجودة على عمليات الفحص والتحليل. المحافظة على العينات وسلامة تخزينها والتعامل معها وفق الإجراءات المعتمدة. المحافظة على نظافة وترتيب المختبر والأجهزة والمعدات. الإبلاغ عن الأعطال والملاحظات الفنية المتعلقة بالأجهزة أو العينات. توثيق الأعمال والنتائج وإعداد التقارير المخبرية حسب متطلبات العمل. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على تنفيذ الأعمال الفنية والمخبرية بدقة. معرفة بإجراءات ومعايير الاختبارات الكيميائية والمخبرية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تشغيل الأجهزة والمعدات المخبرية. الدقة في تسجيل وتوثيق نتائج التحاليل. الالتزام بمتطلبات الجودة والسلامة المهنية. التعامل الآمن مع العينات والمواد الكيميائية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة نجران، وتتطلب العمل ضمن بيئة مختبرية تتطلب الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة. الالتزام والمعايير يجب على المتقدم الالتزام بتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية عند التعامل مع المواد الكيميائية والعينات، بالإضافة إلى الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات المختبر والمعايير المعتمدة في الجودة والسلامة.

c54d0bd857a3c4ff.description: About the Role Luxury Collection is seeking a Guest Experience Expert to join their team. This full-time role, open to Saudi nationals only, focuses on creating memorable and unique experiences for guests throughout their stay, moving beyond standard check-in and check-out procedures. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Role Overview The Guest Experience Expert is empowered to deliver a wide range of services, guiding guests from arrival to departure. This role emphasizes proactive service delivery and the ability to take initiative to meet guest needs and operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Process operational needs efficiently. Address and resolve guest requests promptly. Complete required reports accurately. Share information about local attractions and highlights with guests. Requirements and Standards Maintain a safe workplace environment. Adhere to all company policies and procedures. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information. Protect company assets. Uphold established quality standards. Ensure professional uniform, personal appearance, and communication at all times. Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. c5c330e0341c9be5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في العيون، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى دعم مهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة الإلكترونية والمعدات، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات. دراسة المخططات الفنية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين أثناء عمليات تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. إجراء اختبارات شاملة للأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. تنفيذ عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال فنيي الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. معرفة قوية بمكونات الأجهزة الإلكترونية وطرق تركيبها وصيانتها. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بكفاءة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة سراكو في مدينة العيون بمنطقة القصيم. سيعمل الفني بشكل وثيق مع مهندسي الإلكترونيات وغيرهم من المتخصصين لضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات. المهارات الشخصية الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع مهام التركيب والصيانة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الزملاء. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الفنية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

c5fcb956b23a9add.description: موظفة خدمة عملاء وكول سنتر فرصة وظيفية للسعوديات في الرياض – حي العليا نعلن عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى موظفة خدمة عملاء ومركز اتصال (Call Center)، للعمل حضوريًا في حي العليا بمدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق عمل احترافي ومميز. تفاصيل الوظيفة * المسمى الوظيفي: موظفة خدمة عملاء وكول سنتر. * الجنسية: سعودية فقط. * موقع العمل: الرياض – حي العليا. * نوع العمل: حضوري. * الدوام: صباحي. * الراتب الأساسي. * المزايا المالية: عمولات وحوافز إضافية مقابل المواعيد المؤكدة، وفق آلية الاستحقاق المعتمدة لدى الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات: التواصل مع العملاء هاتفيًا وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة عن خدمات الشركة. تحديد المواعيد مع العملاء ومتابعتها والتأكد من تأكيدها. متابعة العملاء وتحديث بياناتهم وتوثيق المواعيد في النظام المعتمد. الرد على استفسارات العملاء والتعامل مع طلباتهم باحترافية. الالتزام بجودة التواصل وتحقيق الأهداف المطلوبة. المساهمة في رفع نسبة المواعيد المؤكدة وتحقيق مؤشرات الأداء المستهدفة. Requirements أن تكون المتقدمة سعودية الجنسية. وجود خبرة سابقة في خدمة العملاء أو الكول سنتر أو التنسيق الهاتفي للمواعيد. مهارات تواصل وإقناع ممتازة ولباقة في الحديث. القدرة على متابعة العملاء وتحويل الاستفسارات إلى مواعيد مؤكدة. إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وتسجيل البيانات. الالتزام والانضباط والقدرة على تحقيق الأهداف.

c51a45dac70c7048.description: تصنيع أجنحة المعارض والمسارح والديكورات والمنصات الخشبية قص وتجميع وتشطيب الخشب وألواح MDF والأبلكاش حسب المخططات التركيب والفك في مواقع الفعاليات والمعارض تنفيذ التعديلات والإصلاحات السريعة في الموقع تشغيل معدات الورشة والمحافظة عليها الالتزام بإجراءات السلامة ومواعيد التسليم خبرة لا تقل عن 1 سنوات في النجارة، ويفضّل في المعارض والفعاليات القدرة على قراءة المخططات الفنية خبرة في CNC ميزة إضافية الاستعداد للعمل الميداني وساعات عمل مرنة (ليلي / نهاية الأسبوع حسب الفعاليات) إقامة قابلة للنقل

c5e4dcc185f01f97.description: About the Role Astek Middle East is seeking an experienced Digital Marketing & Digital Channels Expert to manage digital marketing operations and optimize digital channels for a leading organization in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves end-to-end ownership of website performance, search visibility, content execution, paid campaigns, and analytics. The position requires a professional who can independently execute digital initiatives and address technical and marketing challenges. Role Responsibilities Own and optimize corporate websites, landing pages, microsites, social media accounts, search presence, and other digital properties. Manage website content, CMS publishing, metadata, redirects, indexing, sitemaps, structured data, and bilingual page quality. Develop and execute SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) initiatives to improve organic visibility across Google and AI-powered search platforms. Conduct Arabic and English keyword research, search-intent analysis, competitor research, and content optimization.
